description.value: Chloe's Diner is a diner-style restaurant located in Merritt, BC, a hub community on cycling routes through the Nicola Valley and Thompson-Okanagan region. Merritt sits at the convergence of several highways and gravel routes, making a sit-down diner a practical stop for touring cyclists passing through. The classic diner format typically offers hearty, filling meals suited to high-output riding days.
